facts.fact: The Nigerian Communications Commission issued a July 2025 consultation paper with seven regulatory proposals for reviewing its Internet Code of Practice 2019, open for 30 days to licensees, consumers, government agencies and civil society organisations, with comments due by 29 August 2025.
